series occurrence

  • CURIE: gmeow:seriesOccurrence
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/seriesOccurrence
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/events
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Relates an event series to one of the concrete event occurrences it issues.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:EventSeries -> gmeow:Event

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:seriesOccurrence from gmeow:EventSeries to gmeow:Event when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:EventSeries, gmeow:Event

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to link a gmeow:EventSeries to a concrete gmeow:Event occurrence it issued — the series-rooted direction of the planned/actual relation.

Avoid when

  • Avoid asserting it when gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries reads more naturally (the occurrence-rooted inverse), and avoid using it to carry the recurrence rule (that is gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule).

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:seriesOccurrence from the series to each issued event, or its inverse gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries from the event; one direction suffices.

Examples

  • ex:standup gmeow:seriesOccurrence ex:standup20240603.
